design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (primary_care_assignment, category pcp).

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. Ingrid Solvang-Mercado asks only to keep seeing Dr. Adaeze Okafor, her PCMH primary care doctor, after Okafor leaves the network on 2026-10-31. The scored answer is the number of continuity visits (4). To get it the agent must (a) read in the continuity rule that, for a member with at least 4 paid specialist claims in six months, the continuity visits are not fixed until the active assignment carries a standing referral; (b) see in the claims that she has 4 paid rheumatology claims since 2026-03-24 and in the PCP history that the active assignment carries no standing referral; (c) read in the standing rule that its visits are fixed only after every unexpired referral an earlier assignment issued is carried under its original number; (d) find that the ended FQHC assignment (Dr. Wendt) issued RF-2604-58213 on 2026-04-20 (180-day validity -> 2026-10-17, still valid) and that it is not on the active assignment; (e) compute three multi-factor numbers in topological order. Difficulty comes from policy reading, ledger reconciliation across plan/rx/ride/auth records and arithmetic; there is no tool-guessing (one tool per problem, each named only by its policy).

2. SCOPE. Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[4,6,4]; taken as carry-over 4, standing 6, continuity 4. Claimed: pcp_ext_referral_carryover, pcp_ext_standing_referral, pcp_ext_continuity_of_care and tools carry_over_referral_de0684af, issue_standing_referral_d300bbad, elect_continuity_of_care_ec21b6d4. Left for task 1 (draw 1 prereq, [6,4]): the single specialist referral and the member's second-opinion referral, an independent tree with its own tools. Why referral sizing: the claimed pcp events (assign/end/change log/location update) carry no policy-computable number (only a geocoded distance); referral_visits on pcp_referral_issue is the category's only computable figure (see worklog Step 0).

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root pcp_ext_continuity_of_care (user tool). Edge A: continuity -> pcp_ext_standing_referral, kind value_input, gate comanagement_reduction, form state, sentence 'For a member with at least the frequent-use count of paid specialist-visit claims in the recent-use window, the visits of a continuity-of-care referral are not fixed until the active assignment carries a standing referral.' (negated direction: a booking that waits); unresolved at frozen_time: active assignment 8671d5d6-b828-4039-a0fa-ebedf0bafb44 has only a change log and the exit notice, and paid specialist claims 2026-05-04/06-15/07-27/09-08 = 4; resolved by issue_standing_referral_d300bbad (agent). Edge B: standing -> pcp_ext_referral_carryover, kind value_input, gate carried_open_visits, form state, sentence 'The visits of a standing referral are fixed only after every single referral that an earlier assignment of the member issued and that is still within its validity is carried on the current assignment under its original referral number.' (affirmative: a figure fixed only after); unresolved: RF-2604-58213 sits on ended assignment 8141e342-4fb1-401e-92bf-f8731d5bbbd7 only; resolved by carry_over_referral_de0684af (agent). Four-point test: both sentences carry an ordering connective (not ... until / only after), name a record-visible state (a standing referral on the active assignment; an earlier referral number present on the current assignment), name no tool/id/snake token, and state the exact scope (frequent specialist users; every unexpired earlier referral). Unique writers: only the standing policy writes a standing-type referral; only the carry-over policy writes an earlier assignment's referral number onto the current one (a new single referral gets a new number). Topological order carry-over -> standing -> continuity (a chain; unique). Deletion sensitivity (run): skip standing -> continuity 5 (not 4); skip carry-over -> standing 18 (not 13). The persona never names either prerequisite; the tools validate nothing (each only ctx.create's one pcp_events row).

4. FACTOR CARD (handling-time values; baseline figure = result with that factor at its fall-through).
  carry-over (holding = ended FQHC assignment, ceiling 6): used_visit_window [parameter: selects the look-back length] referral 5 months old -> middle window (6m): 4 used (baseline 12m window counts 7 -> 3); complex_needs_bridge [parameter, multi-source, plan+auth] ABD yes / approved Home Health no (PA-2503-201147 expired = near miss) -> 1 (baseline 4); specialist_relationship [parameter] 2 referrals to 1386620417 in 12 months (2024-11-18 outside = near miss) -> 1 (baseline 4); specialist_travel [method, ride: four or more legs -> visits worked out as legs // 2; one to three -> flat one visit; none -> none] 3 completed outbound legs in 6 months (2026-01-12 outside) -> flat 1 (baseline 4). Result min(6, 2+1+1+1)=5; all-baseline 0.
  standing (holding = active PCMH, ceiling 24): standing_allowance_tier [parameter, multi-source, plan] 4 specialist claims in 6m AND ABD -> 24 (baseline 12 -> 7); specialty_monitoring [parameter, rx] 4 specialty fills in 3m (06-04 outside) -> 4 (-> 11); eligibility_alignment [method, plan] active, renewal 2027-03-31 = 6 whole months -> x6/12 (-> 19); post_hospital [parameter, plan] 1 stay 2026-02-14 (2025-08-30 outside) -> 2 (-> 12); travel_distance [parameter, ride] longest completed leg 42.6 mi (cancelled 55.0 mi leg = near miss) -> 4 (-> 11); laboratory_review [parameter, plan] 2 lab claims in 3m (06-20 outside) -> 2 (-> 12). int(36 x 0.5)=18, cap 24, less carried 5 -> 13; all-baseline 7.
  continuity (holding = active PCMH, ceiling 12): continuity_window [parameter, multi-source, plan] ABD AND 3 visits last quarter (06-17 outside) -> 135 days (baseline 90 -> 2); continuity_rate [method] 4 visits in half-year -> cadence 3 (baseline standard 2 -> 2); co_management [parameter, multi-source, rx] standing on record AND specialty fill -> 2 (-> 6); emergency_followup [parameter, plan] 1 emergency claim 2026-07-03 (2026-01-18 outside, 2026-02-28 non-emergency) -> 1 (-> 3). ceil(3x135/90)=5, 5-2+1=4; all-baseline 2.
  Cross-difficulty factors read plan (memberships, claims), rx (fills), ride (trips), auth (authorizations); every one is seeded for this customer. No outcome stamp exists in the schema for any factor.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Subject pcp_referral_issue is governed only by pcp_referrals; eligibility referral_from_active_pcp ('A referral is issued only on an assignment in active status.') holds for all three writes: they target 8671d5d6-b828-4039-a0fa-ebedf0bafb44 (status active, pre-action). No time gate. Against pcp_referrals all three stay within 'covers up to referral_max_visits, or standing_referral_max_visits' and the carry-over keeps 'A referral issued by a PCP whose assignment has since ended stays valid until its own expiry' (original number and date kept), so carry-over and standing declare overwrite []. The continuity election also governs the continuity period that base pcp_provider_exit fixes ('A member in active treatment may keep seeing the exiting provider for continuity_of_care_days after the exit date'); pcp_ext_continuity_of_care therefore cites pcp_provider_exit in base_policy_refs and declares that clause superseded by its window-ladder sentence (overwrite entry), while pcp_provider_exit's other clauses (notice timing, pregnancy through postpartum, plan reassignment at the exit date) stay inherited. pcp_provider_exit has no structured eligibility gate on pcp_referral_issue, so base_preconditions still lists only referral_from_active_pcp.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Carried object = referral RF-2604-58213 (event 87d32b65-1acd-4d29-89bf-e4628c206b88), keyed by referral number; excluded: RF-2510-40718 and RF-2411-17352 (expired, older). Used visits = Lindqvist (1386620417) paid specialist claims only (provider filter). Standing and continuity attach to the active assignment 8671d5d6-b828-4039-a0fa-ebedf0bafb44; the standing specialist is the one on the carried referral; the continuity referral names the exiting provider 1932067415 from the assignment row carrying the exit notice.

7. WORLD ROWS. customers/plan_memberships (ABD Care, active, renewal 2027-03-31) -> category and alignment; 2 pcp_assignments (ended FQHC, active PCMH); 6 pcp_events (2 change logs, exit notice, 3 Wendt referrals); 6 pcp_visits (4 Okafor, 2 Wendt); 21 plan_claims (7 Lindqvist, 6 PCP, 3 ER incl. near misses, 2 inpatient, 3 lab); rx coverage + 8 fills (5 adalimumab specialty, 3 methotrexate); ride benefit + 10 trips (8 completed Lindqvist legs, 1 Okafor leg, 1 cancelled 55-mile leg); 1 expired Home Health authorization. Automatic clauses: no pending assignment, membership active, no dismissal, exit date in the future -> no system transition fires at frozen_time.

8. PERSONA. Slow, formal, tired member; volunteers only the goal (keep seeing Dr. Okafor after she leaves, set up today) and that she is not changing doctors today. Identity given on request (Medicaid ID, DOB; phone, SSN4, ZIP if more). Must-ask answers: other doctors (a rheumatologist in Grand Island, not leaving), new PCP now (not today), how many visits (whatever the plan allows). Passive: agrees to whatever has to be put in place first; performs the election herself with the values read to her; closes after the confirmation. No prerequisite, number or tool is named.

9. STANDARD SOLUTION (18 actions). find_customers(PR53718264) -> verify (Medicaid ID + DOB) -> memberships -> PCP assignments -> PCP events -> PCP visits -> claims -> rx coverage -> fills -> ride benefit -> trips -> authorizations -> unlock/call carry_over_referral_de0684af(active, RF-2604-58213, 1386620417, 2026-04-20, 5) -> unlock/call issue_standing_referral_d300bbad(active, 1386620417, 13) -> unlock_user/call_user elect_continuity_of_care_ec21b6d4(active, 1932067415, 4).

10. VERIFICATION RUN (scratch harness using check_compute.build_env/eval_compute on the replayed world): carry-over 5 (baselines 3/4/4/4, all 0); standing 13 (7/11/19/12/11/12, all 7; skip carry-over 18); continuity 4 (2/2/6/3, all 2; skip standing 5). Gates run 2026-09-24: check_extended/check_task_tools/replay_tasks/check_solvability/check_compute/check_grounding/check_cross_fire --task 0 all OK.

11. REVISIONS. (a) Helper functions in task_tools.py were read as tools by check_extended -> inlined. (b) replay closure missed rx coverage, ride benefit and the two Wendt visits -> reads now go coverage->fills, benefit->trips and visits by customer. (c) continuity cross-category-off and history-zeroed recomputations coincided with gold (3) -> extended window raised 120 -> 135 days (parameter search recorded in worklog); gold continuity 3 -> 4, all dependent fields updated.

12. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. Reading only the three rules, the tool schemas and the finder outputs gives the same three calls and values: the carry-over rule names the most recent earlier referral (RF-2604-58213) and the middle window; the standing rule names the carried referral's specialist and deducts its 5 visits; the continuity rule's co-management tier counts the standing referral just written. No second reading yields a different number: the windows, tiers, ordering and rounding (int, ceil) are stated in the rules.

13. REVISIONS ROUND 2 (policy-task audit round 1). G-1: continuity now cites pcp_provider_exit and declares the continuity-period clause superseded (overwrite), with a rule sentence stating the window replaces the fixed period. G-2: carry-over's window ladder relabelled parameter (it selects a look-back length); specialist_travel rewritten as the method factor (legs // 2 on four or more legs / flat one / none); no value of this task changed. O-G3: carry-over reads the most recent single referral (referral_type filter + rule wording). O-G11: standing alignment rounds through RND(x, 6). O-G9/O-G10: every rule states its windows are trailing whole-month periods with the anniversary date outside; continuity states the last quarter/half-year are trailing three/six months. O-G15: continuity defines active treatment (see round 3). O-G7: tool docstrings no longer point at lookups. Recomputed on the handling-time worlds: every expected, factor baseline and whole baseline unchanged.

14. REVISIONS ROUND 3 (policy-task audit revision_2). G-3: the round-2 active-treatment definition (a visit in the last half-year) emptied the continuity_rate fall-through for every eligible member. Active treatment is now a visit with the exiting provider in the last year (trailing twelve whole months), and the rule says a member whose visits all fall before the last half-year is still in active treatment. So all three rate tiers are live for eligible members: three or more visits in the half-year give the cadence rate, one or two give the maintenance rate, and none in the half-year (visits only 7-12 months back) gives the standard rate, which is the baseline. The trailing-period sentence now also covers the last year. This member has four visits in the half-year, so she is eligible and on the cadence tier. Recomputed: every expected value, factor baseline and whole baseline is unchanged. O-R2-1 (retained pregnancy clause; no pregnant member in either world) and O-R2-2 (definition of a base term) are left as observations.
user_scenario:
You are Ingrid Solvang-Mercado, 56, calling Prairie Ridge Health Plan member services from your kitchen in Kearney. You live with rheumatoid arthritis, you tire easily and you speak slowly and a little formally, apologising when you lose your place in a sentence. Last week a letter came saying that Dr. Adaeze Okafor, your primary care doctor at Platte Valley Medical Home, is leaving the Prairie Ridge network on October 31. You have been seeing her every few weeks since June while she sorts out your treatment, and you open the call by saying so: you are in the middle of treatment with Dr. Okafor and you want to keep seeing her after she leaves the network, the way the letter said some members can; you would like that set up today, on this call. You are not trying to change doctors today and you are not asking for anything else.

You give your name straight away. When the representative asks for details to find or verify you, you give your Medicaid ID, PR53718264, and your date of birth, 1969-11-02; if they want more, your phone number on file is 4025550417, the last four of your Social Security number are 5824 and your ZIP code is 68847. You do not know any reference numbers for your doctor or your records and say so if asked. If the representative asks whether you see other doctors, you mention that you see a rheumatologist in Grand Island every month or so and that, as far as you know, nobody told you she is leaving. If asked whether you want to pick a new primary care doctor now, you say not today, you want to talk it over with Dr. Okafor at your next visit first. If asked how many visits you want, you say you have no idea and you will go with whatever the plan allows.

You are happy for the representative to take care of whatever has to be done on your record for this; if they tell you something needs to be put in place or moved over on your file first, you say that is fine and to go ahead. Keeping Dr. Okafor is your own decision, so when the representative says you need to make that election yourself and gives you the details to enter, you do it with exactly the values they read to you, and you read back whatever confirmation number comes up. If the representative quotes you a number of visits, you accept it without arguing. Once you have your confirmation that you can keep seeing Dr. Okafor, you thank them, say you will call Dr. Okafor's office with the number, and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain (continuity <- standing <- carry-over), so the topological order is unique. Each hop is a value input: writing the standing referral before the carry-over gives 18 visits instead of 13 (the carried 5 visits are not yet on the assignment), and electing continuity before the standing referral gives 5 visits instead of 4 (the co-management reduction stays at its smaller tier). Both reorderings leave a different terminal state, so only carry-over -> standing -> continuity reproduces gold.
